meta.topic: Tartan Army beer economics - World Cup 2026 (Scotland vs Haiti Jun 14 & Morocco Jun 19 at Gillette Stadium/Boston, vs Brazil Jun 24 at Hard Rock Stadium/Miami)

gbp_usd_rate.source: exchangerates.org.uk / Pound Sterling Live (GBP/USD daily history)

uk_average_gbp.note: UK average pint, up 6% from GBP 5.17 in 2024

edinburgh_gbp.note: Most expensive city in Scotland for a pint; a pint of Guinness averages GBP 6.08 (March 2026)
edinburgh_gbp.source: Edinburgh Evening News / The Drinks Business

glasgow_gbp.note: Average Guinness price; Glasgow is one of only two UK cities where a pint of the stout is still under GBP 5
glasgow_gbp.source: The Drinks Business (March 2026 Guinness price survey)

boston_bar_usd.note: Average beer in a neighbourhood pub; Boston is among the highest-priced US markets and happy hour is banned in Massachusetts

miami_bar_usd.note: Reports range USD 7 (NBC Miami night-out cost report) to USD 8 (Expatistan neighbourhood pub); US restaurant/bar median was USD 6.45 in July 2025 (Toast POS data)

gillette_stadium_boston_gbp.source: GiveMeSport stadium pint price survey, June 2026

hard_rock_stadium_miami_gbp.source: GiveMeSport stadium pint price survey, June 2026

most_expensive.stadiums: SoFi Stadium (Los Angeles) and Levi's Stadium (San Francisco)

cheapest.stadiums: Estadio Akron (Guadalajara) and Estadio Azteca (Mexico City)

england_friendly_observed_usd.note: Prices that stunned England fans at the England vs New Zealand US friendly days before the tournament; FIFA venues also reported USD 8.75 water
england_friendly_observed_usd.source: Yahoo Sports / SportBible / Open Magazine, June 2026

scottish_beers_us.availability: Widest US footprint of any Scottish brewer: 100,000 sq ft US brewery and HQ in Columbus, Ohio (DogTap), bars in Columbus/New Albany/Cleveland (OH), Columbus Airport, Atlanta (GA), and a 30,000 sq ft, 1,300-capacity rooftop bar on the Las Vegas Strip (its biggest bar worldwide). Beer in retail nationwide.
scottish_beers_us.note: NO BrewDog bar in Boston or Miami - the nearest experiences to the Scotland venues are retail cans/taps, not BrewDog's own bars.
scottish_beers_us.source: usa.brewdog.com bar locator / Craft Brewing Business / HMSHost

scottish_beers_us.availability: Nationally imported by Total Beverage Solution (Tennent's 1885 Lager 16.9oz cans returned to US retail); available in stores, bars and via online retailers.
scottish_beers_us.note: Approximately 300 kegs of Tennent's were shipped to Boston specifically for the World Cup, ~120 of them to The Haven pub in Jamaica Plain - STV headlined it 'Tennent's galore'.
scottish_beers_us.source: Total Beverage Solution / tennents.com US / STV News / Boston 25 News

scottish_beers_us.availability: Imported by United States Beverage; sold in 20+ countries; The Original (scotch-whisky-barrel-aged golden beer) widely stocked via US specialty retailers and wine-searcher-listed stores.
scottish_beers_us.note: Scotland's most-awarded craft brewer; sells via local stockists rather than direct-to-consumer in the US.
scottish_beers_us.source: United States Beverage / innisandgunn.com US site / Wine-Searcher

scottish_beers_us.availability: Greene King-owned Scottish brewery (Scotland's oldest working brewery); Belhaven Scottish Ale and Scottish Stout have long been exported to the US and appear at US specialty beer retailers, though distribution is patchier than Tennent's or Innis & Gunn.
scottish_beers_us.note: Current dedicated US importer not confirmed in 2026 reporting.

scottish_beers_us.availability: Available through US specialty bottle shops and online craft retailers - e.g. Old Engine Oil (6% black ale/stout) stocked at Binny's (Chicago), Metro Wine & Spirits and Hop Cask & Barrel (Washington DC), and CraftShack online (not shipped to NY, NH, PA).
scottish_beers_us.note: Cult favourite; its whisky-cask Ola Dubh series also reaches US specialty shops.

czechia.note: World #1 for the 32nd consecutive year (Czech brewers association; Kirin-based lists cite 128.0)
czechia.source: Czech Beer and Malt Association via Wikipedia / Kirin Holdings

usa.note: 27th of 170 countries per capita; #2 in the world by total volume

uk_scotland.note: UK-wide figure; no separate official Scotland-only series

brazil.note: World's #3 beer market by total volume, behind China and the USA

morocco.note: Majority-Muslim country; total alcohol consumption only ~0.5 L pure alcohol per capita (World Bank, 2020) - roughly 1/50th of Scottish-level beer drinking
morocco.source: FAOSTAT via Helgi Library / World Bank

haiti.note: Estimates range from 0.22 L (Helgi Library, 2020) to ~1.3 L; rum dominates. Local lager Prestige (BRANA, Port-au-Prince, 5.6% ABV, launched 1976) holds ~98% of the domestic beer market

jefferies_pint_forecast.detail: Jefferies (analyst Ed Mundy, note published 27 April 2026) forecasts the tournament will drive consumption of over 1 billion pints of beer worldwide, a 0.3% lift to global beer industry volumes; 'match timing is the unsung hero' - Europe/Americas games were largely scheduled into peak 5pm-11pm local drinking windows. AB InBev expected to be the biggest winner.

global_gdp_boost_usd.detail: FIFA/WTO socioeconomic impact analysis (March 2025): up to $40.9B added to global GDP (~$41B), 824,000 full-time-equivalent jobs, 13.1 million visitors and 21+ million hotel nights across the three host nations; US share ~$17.2B
global_gdp_boost_usd.source: FIFA World Cup 2026 Socioeconomic Impact Analysis / beIN Sports

sofi_stadium_beer_sales_usd.detail: SoFi Stadium (LA) projected to sell nearly $15M of beer across its 8 World Cup matches - described as enough beer to fill 1.2 million Starbucks Venti cups

att_stadium_dallas_beer_sales_usd.detail: Dallas expects $11.7M in AT&T Stadium beer sales during its World Cup matches

mexico_host_city_beer_uplift_pct.detail: Deloitte: beer sales in Mexico City, Guadalajara and Monterrey could rise up to 9.9% during the tournament (triple the usual period profit); beer expected to account for 55-65% of all Mexico World Cup-related spending; craft beer sales in restaurants/tasting rooms could spike up to 300%
mexico_host_city_beer_uplift_pct.source: Deloitte via Mexico News Daily / Mexico Business News

boston_economic_impact.detail: Seven matches at Gillette Stadium (temporarily renamed 'Boston Stadium') projected to pump ~$1.1B into the Greater Boston economy, with $60M+ in tax revenue, ~5,000 new jobs and up to 2 million visitors to the region; earlier BCG estimate was up to $500M with 450,000 visitors
boston_economic_impact.source: WROR / GBH News / CBS Boston / NBC Boston

budweiser_sponsorship.detail: AB InBev has been FIFA's official beer sponsor since 1986 (40 years - celebrated with a 'Budstalgia' campaign); Budweiser and Michelob ULTRA are official beer sponsors of World Cup 2026; Budweiser's global 2026 platform is 'Let It Pour' fronted by Erling Haaland and Jurgen Klopp; the prior cycle's sponsorship was reported at ~$75M; advocacy group Big Alcohol Exposed estimates AB InBev's total 2026 alcohol-marketing machine at $7.2B
budweiser_sponsorship.source: AB InBev / FIFA / ESPN / VinePair / BigAlcohol Exposed

beer_in_stands.detail: Unlike Qatar 2022 (stadium sales banned days before kickoff; still 1.2M litres sold in restricted areas), alcohol sales will be permitted in general seating areas across all 2026 host nations, subject to local law; some venues (e.g. BC Place, Vancouver) will offer alcohol-free family sections; some US states and New York have temporarily relaxed drinking laws for the tournament. William Hill projects at least 3 million litres (5.2M+ pints) sold across venues and fan zones.
beer_in_stands.source: Football Ground Guide / Newsweek / William Hill News

tartan_army.detail: Tens of thousands of Scotland fans expected in the US (STV: 'Tartan Army Exodus'); Boston-area businesses are preparing for roughly 40,000 Scots; ~200,000 Scots travelled to Euro 2024 in Germany. This is Scotland's first World Cup finals in 28 years (since France 1998).
tartan_army.source: STV News / Boston 25 News / Yahoo Sports-AFP

matches.venue: Hard Rock Stadium, Miami Gardens FL

the_haven.detail: The Haven, Jamaica Plain - Boston's ONLY Scottish pub (owner Jason Waddleton) - is serving as a Tartan Army headquarters: ~300 kegs of Tennent's shipped to Boston with ~120 going to the pub; hosting 'HOME GROUND', a three-day football festival with Scottish trivia, whisky tastings, live music, DJs and an outdoor supporter festival

the_greatest_bar.detail: The Greatest Bar (near TD Garden) billed as an official Tartan Army headquarters in Boston: four floors, massive screens, themed spaces and nightly international after-parties during the tournament
